title: Self-healing IT Support App (guided troubleshooting + fix playbooks)

requirements.text: Implement Internet Identity sign-in and use the authenticated principal as the user identity for all saved troubleshooting sessions and history.

quotes: self heal app for IT support

acceptanceCriteria: A signed-out user is prompted to sign in with Internet Identity before creating or viewing troubleshooting sessions.
Troubleshooting sessions created after sign-in are associated with the caller principal in the backend.
A user can only view their own troubleshooting history.

requirements.text: Create a guided “Issue Intake” flow where a user selects an issue category (e.g., Network/Wi‑Fi, VPN, Email, Printer, Slow Computer, Account/Password, Software Install) and answers a short symptom questionnaire to generate a troubleshooting session.

quotes: self heal app for IT support

acceptanceCriteria: The user can start a new troubleshooting session from the home screen.
The intake flow captures: category, a short title, symptom selections, and optional free-text notes.
Submitting the intake creates a new session and navigates to a session detail view.

requirements.text: Add backend support for troubleshooting sessions, including creating a session, updating its status (in_progress/resolved/escalated), appending step outcomes, and listing sessions for the current user.

quotes: self heal app for IT support

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes methods to: createSession, getSession, listMySessions, recordStepResult, setSessionStatus.
Sessions persist across page reloads and can be retrieved later by the same principal.
Attempting to access a session owned by a different principal is rejected.

requirements.text: Provide a built-in catalog of common IT issues with guided troubleshooting steps (“runbooks”), including decision points and clear instructions, and show the recommended runbook in the session detail view.

quotes: self heal app for IT support

acceptanceCriteria: At least 6 categories are available with at least 3 issues/runbooks per category (minimum 18 runbooks total).
Each runbook is composed of ordered steps with: title, instruction text, and an expected user action (e.g., confirm/yes-no/mark-done).
The session detail view displays the recommended runbook based on the selected category/symptoms and allows the user to proceed step-by-step.

requirements.text: Support “automated fixes” as safe, simulated actions (since the app cannot directly control the user’s device), by presenting one-click actions that record an outcome and show what to do on the device (copyable commands or UI navigation) rather than executing system changes.

quotes: self heal app for IT support

acceptanceCriteria: Steps can include an optional “Quick Action” button that (a) copies a command/snippet or (b) reveals concise instructions, and (c) records that the user attempted it.
The UI clearly labels quick actions as guided/simulated (no device changes are executed by the app).

requirements.text: Add troubleshooting outcomes and escalation support: users can mark a session resolved, or escalate it by generating a concise incident summary (symptoms, steps attempted, results) that can be copied for an IT ticket.

quotes: self heal app for IT support

acceptanceCriteria: A session can be marked Resolved, which locks step editing and records a resolution timestamp.
A session can be marked Escalated and produces a copyable summary text block.
The summary includes: category, title, symptoms, notes, and a chronological list of steps + outcomes.

requirements.text: Create a “History” view where users can search and filter their past sessions by status and category, and open a session to review the troubleshooting timeline.

quotes: self heal app for IT support

acceptanceCriteria: The history list loads the current user’s sessions from the backend.
Users can filter by status and category and search by title/notes.
Selecting a session opens a read-only timeline of steps and results.

requirements.text: Apply a coherent, distinctive visual theme for an IT support product and enforce it consistently across pages (typography, spacing, components, and tone), using English for all user-facing text.

quotes: Use English for any user-facing text in the build request.

acceptanceCriteria: All visible UI text is in English.
The app uses a consistent theme (e.g., neutral/slate + accent color) across navigation, cards, buttons, and forms without mixing styles.
Key screens (Start/Intake, Session Detail, History) share consistent layout and components.

requirements.text: Generate required static image assets and render them in the UI from frontend/public/assets/generated (do not fetch images through the backend).

quotes: self heal app for IT support

acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced directly by the frontend.
The app displays a logo in the header and a hero/illustration on the landing/start screen.
Category icons are used in the issue category selection UI.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them only).
Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
nonGoals: Direct device management (e.g., actually resetting network adapters, editing registry, changing OS settings) from the app.
Real-time chat or live agent messaging.
Third-party auth providers other than Internet Identity.
Integration with external ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira) beyond copyable escalation summaries.

required: Minimalist wrench+spark logo, flat vector style, dark on transparent background (selfheal-logo.dim_512x512.png)
Isometric IT support desk illustration with laptop, router, and checklist, soft neutral palette (it-support-hero.dim_1600x900.png)
Set of 6 flat monochrome category icons (network, vpn, email, printer, performance, account) on transparent background (category-icons-sprite.dim_1024x1024.png)
